buckets.accepted-ownership-evidence: The relationship category may contribute an exact_mappings[poetry_id] = source_id entry, subject to the row-level rules (resolved status, canonical endpoints, exactly one owner).
buckets.semantic-not-ownership: The relationship category is a real semantic connection but does not, on its own, name the record that owns a poetry record.
buckets.structural: The relationship category encodes repository structure (parent/child), not editorial ownership.
buckets.ambiguous-review: Reserved for categories whose ownership meaning is contested; no such whole-category entry exists today. Row-level contested claims (one poetry id claimed by multiple owners) are reported per row as ambiguous_ownership findings, never resolved by selection.
buckets.irrelevant: The relationship category never carries poetry ownership meaning.

mascotRef.rationale: A poetry record declares the mascot it is about. The declaring record is the poem; the resolved target is the owning mascot. This is the strongest directional ownership signal in the archive: each mascot's verse set is named by its records.

relatedMascots.rationale: A poetry record lists the mascots its verse belongs to. Same ownership semantics as mascotRef: the poem maps to the mascot it names. Where a poetry record names several mascots, the exactly-one-owner rule reports an ambiguous_ownership finding instead of choosing.

relatedHaiku.rationale: A source record (lorelog) declares a haiku that belongs to it. The declared haiku is the poem; the declaring record is the owner. Direction-independent handling: the poetry endpoint is whichever side resolves to a poetry collection and the source endpoint the side that resolves to an eligible source collection.

relatedLimerick.rationale: A source record (lorelog) declares a limerick that belongs to it. Same ownership semantics as relatedHaiku.

relatedEntries.rationale: Generic related-entry links between arbitrary record kinds (lorelog-to-lorelog, reference-to-aphorism, mascot-to-mascot, ...). There is no directional owner meaning; accepting it would fabricate ownership from broad cross-links and manufacture thousands of contested claims. Rejected as ownership evidence.

parentEntry.rationale: The repository parent relationship (collection grouping). Excluded from the recovered semantic map at recovery time (1632 rows, metadata/relationship-recovery.json structural_only). Never ownership evidence.
